nom: COSRX The Peptide Collagen Hydrogel Eye Patch

avis.texte: These eye patches are very comfortable and soothing to my skin. Make sure you only get one eye patch at a time. The first time o used them I ended up with two under each eye.
These are amazing under eye patches! Definitely will be buying on the regular.
Good molecule eye patches were sold out so I tried these ones… I havent gone back. It foednt leave anything behind like the good molecule and stays in place

Was stressing about attending to an event where I need to be glam but my eyebags where horrible. It's been years trying so many different things for my under eyes. I got this because every ingredient listed sounded perfect for my issue. After one time of use my eyebags went down over 50%. I haven't felt this confident about my face in years. So crazy how the appearance of the eyes can make such a big difference. Will definitely continue to use this forever. 🙌
This product helped me with puffy eyes and it's just make my skin glow
The formula seems fine. However, they are WAY too slippery. They do not stay in place. I do not have time to lay back and relax so they are not for me.

It's only been a week, but so far I am getting good results from the product. I try to use it on a daily basis if I am not too tired and forget. I have used a similar product in the past, but this one seems to be a little more effective and gives me the desired results.
These are slippery little buggers, but they do make a big difference in the skin under my eyes. At 44 my under eye skin is so thin and frustrating, but these help

I love how cool and calming these feel, but you do have to be careful to prevent them from sliding down your face. Do i notice a difference in my under eyes? Not a ton, but theres still time to tell. There are a lot of patches per a container.

avis.titre: I'm 59 and I love these…just buy them.
avis.texte: Perfect for sensitive eyes. I have tried my brands. These are my personal favorite. Clean ingredients. Great price.
Was excited to try these, on the hunt for affordable and effective eye patches… unfortunately they just slip down, wouldn't buy again.

I do enjoy this product, it feels really nice on my skin. I have not used it long enough to see if it helps what I am intending it to, but it has seemed great so far. The only thing I have noticed is that it does slide around my under eyes a lot so if you plan to multitask and move around while using this, be mindful of that as it will move around.
The oroduxt is saturated with oriduct whixh inguess is a good thing…. But it is hard to pick up even with the tool and the patches slide down. I dod not see sny difference to my under eyes at all.
Love these! Although they do slide a little bit, its to be expected with any slippery product. They feel SO soothing and refreshing. Fhey are great for puffiness.
I tried these on a whim and love them. When I was out of them for a week, my under eyes could tell. Highly recommend!

I got these as a gift and wanted to love them so bad. I'm not sure how people are using these and having them stay on their face. They are just too wet. I know I could probably wipe off some of the gel before using them, but why should I have to?

avis.titre: Good Product!  Will definitely buy again & use regularly.
avis.texte: Love this product. They do not slide or move once placed on face or neck. THEY WORK! I use under my eyes, on my forehead, on frown lines by mouth and my neck. Noticeable difference with eye puffiness & wrinkles after first use. So then I tried on the my forehead, mouth frown lines and neck and they never moved and noticeable difference in all areas after the first use as well. Your face needs to be cleaned & free of makeup or oily creams before applying otherwise they won't work well if not able to penetrate deeply into your skin. After cleaning my face I apply a small amount of retinol cream or collagen serum on my face first and then place the patches. They Never move and they feel great & and work great!!! I've received numerous comments about how great my skin looks and I've only been using them a little more than 2-weeks. Highly recommend!

avis.titre: Bad, no effects even if you manage to keep them in one place
avis.texte: I bought these on sale because the ingredients seemed nice and I tend to love cosrx products. These are bad. When you manage to keep them in one place, you take them off and its like you did nothing. Eyes dont look nicer at all, if anything I feel like they made me look slightly more tired. They slide all over the place and are so hard to get them in place and are poorly shaped for my undereye area. Ive used them twice now and theyre such a pain for no noticeable difference. Most eye masks/gels/patches have an instantly noticeable effect and like i said, maybe it was just the frustration of them slipping all over my face, but I feel I looked mildly worse after using them! 2 stars because the ingredients are solid so maybe theyd work for somebody else who isnt me.
I found these to be effective for brightening the under eye area. so soothing and moisturizing too.

I do not have sensetive skin and I use Eye patches now and then. I had used these three time and the 4th time they left me with a HORRIBLE chemical burn . They are not over saturated at all, in fact the are hard to get out of the container and they slide down your face they do not stay in place like others. I put them on one morning while getting dressed. Maybe they were on for 5 to 10 mintues , i was in a hurry and did not have time to let them sit. Thank goodness cause the chemical burn they left for the short time they were on was awuful. It has taken me a week and a half to heal the burn they left. I still havent gotten it all healed. They are horrible.

When I bought these I thought I would like them alot. I wore them for the first time today and they felt refreshing on the skin at first, but then I noticed the begining of an alergic reaction. Im not sure if it was because I had them on too long or the product itself. I also agree that they are pretty slippery and you have to keep moving them back up. If you have sensitive skin I would be causious buying these, if not they might be perfect for you!

As everyone else said. These slide all over the place. Regardless of trying to remove excess product. If you can get them to stay they do dry down nicely but I saw no real noticeable difference afterwards. There is a burning sensation caused by I assume the caffeine and adenosine. Ill use them because they werent cheap but ultimately I will not recommend or repurchase.

I do not have sensetive diin at all. I was frustrated with how difficult they are to get one parch out, not because they are too wet their not . My 3rd tine using them i ended upcwith a burned dkin bartier undet my eyes , they didnt butn or itch ehile i had thrm in . I keft thrm in nsybe 5 minutes. As soon as i rrmoved them you could ckeatly see the red shap of each patch and it started to burn. Im now left trying to heal a very vad skin barrier isdue. Will bever purchase again

This product was amazing. I just finished my first container and about to purchase more, I can definitely see a difference in my under eyes after I take them off (less dark, less puffy, less "baggy"). I also keep them on for more then the recommended time. Yeah. For the people in the reviews saying it slides off, make sure your skin is completely clean/dry and you can always remove the excess product off the patches with the provided spatula, so it doesn't slide off as easily.
The serum does what it says, but its impossible to get them to stay where they are. Im constantly adjusting them and poking myself in the eye with the ends because they simply do not stay put.

I purchased them because i heard they were good so i tried them in November and i got a horrible reaction where it got red and puffy. It looked like a chemical burn. I didnt think it was the actual patches until i tried them again this week and it did it again. My under eyes look horrible. Never buying this product again.
These patches stick together and slide off. Not worth the hype.
I like the feel of the serum but the patches do not stay put. It is really inconvenient to have to shift them every 15 seconds. I really wanted to like these.

These would slide off my face, no matter if I tried scrapping off the excess serum. Definitely not for sensitive skin, after 3 minutes it would feel like it was burning and up to 20 minutes after taking them off. After two uses it also caused a breakout where the patches would lay.

It's a fun way to get ready for work or before going out. I put them in the morning and drive to work. They do not fall off! I wait for them to completely dry before taking them off. My face feels plump and youthful underneath my eyes.

I had these in my cart before they went viral then finally purchases then aftee seeing the reviews. I used them for the first time this morning…on my dry fresh cleaned face. They slid off my fave the entire time. I fought wirh them for over 5 minutes to keep then in place but it wasnt happening so in the trash they went. And then I have huge red marks on my skin from where they were. Ive used plenty of eye patches and never have had issues keeping them in place like these.

These actually work! Ive tried several eye serums and patches, and it seemed as if they accentuated my bags more than hid them. These are the only ones so far have worked for me. I put them on for 20-30 mins in the morning while im getting ready and i can see am immediate difference. I've also noticed that my bags have pretty much gone away since ive been using these.

I usually prefer Patchology but those always slip down during use. I wanted something goos for sensitive skin and is hydrating and these fit the bill. They stick right away without slipping and feel really nice in my underwye area without any stinging.
This patch is drenched eith product . It diesnt slide down.i feel leas puffy after using.
I absolutely LOVE these patches. the instant plump and juicy undereyes this gives is insane! these are by far my favorite eye patches. I've never had an issue with sliding!
I love how it works on the eyes makes them brighter it's just a little messy to get out.
I love these ,, they are a little slippery at first - best to dab up some product once they're in the right position ,, but they work great !!

avis.titre: Don't stay in place, wouldn't repurchase
avis.texte: Although all the other reviews looked positive, have not enjoyed this product. The eye patches don't stay in place and slide down my face. It doesn't feel relaxing or show any benefit. Wouldn't repurchase these eye patches again.

I usually really like COSRX products but these are a miss for me. They're awkwardly shaped to go under the eye so you usually get some product in your eye. They slide down your face no matter what position you're in. Laying down doesn't help.

Love these under eye patches, they do what they claim. Soothing, refreshing & my over 55 year old eyes look tighter & brighter. Bought when The Sheseido were out of stock & the CORSX are far Superior.

I saw good reviews about these all over so I thought I'd give them a try. I like the serum as its not super stick and doesnt feel tacky after application. They are also cooling when wearing them. But there is too much product in the jar as the patches slide down my face all the time, very annoying. But I like them otherwise
a product that actually does what it says. Saw a difference first time I used it.
I read other reviews that said they stay put so I tried them. They slid all down my face. Bummer. I really wanted to like them.

OMG...not an actual eye patch that STICKS to under eye without sliding down to your face! Once I placed them on to my under eye/face, they didn't MOVE!!! And I was doing house work, painting my nails, moving around, etc., they never budge. Unlike some of their highly priced counter parts. Very cooling and VERY hydrating. The end results great! I will be repurchase these. I do like Pixie patches, and was just wondering what other patches do and feel and if results were any different. Do I think there is any HUGE improvements from any under eye patches, no, none of them are miracle workers. But these patches are definitely 10/10. Thank you for making eye patches that DONT MOVE!!!
Doesn't stay on my face properly and glides down. It's super slippery. And it gives me pimples.
This is the only under eye product I have used that gives me results. It de-puffs my undereye really well and I even feel it helps with fine lines.

Like most reviewers have stated, these patches are VERY slippery. It takes some effort to separate them, and then I hold one in place for about 10-20 seconds before putting on the second patch, otherwise it will slide down my cheek. The results, however, are great. My under eye circles & puffiness are dramatically improved. I'll be getting more of these.
I just bought these for the first time, and use them every morning. Will definitely buy again, and again.
I like these eye patches. The skin in my under eye area feels supple. Helps with the puffiness.
Ive tried so many different eye patches and these might be the best ones ive used yet. They stay in place and make my under eyes feel refreshed.

I like to keep these in the fridge since it makes them stay in place after applying. However, if theres too much product on the patch they will still slide down. I will continue using them because they're the bedt I've tried thus far and give results.
i love that you can get 60 Patches!!! some patches be so pricey and i love the feeling of them . this is high quality and korean I use this in my AM routine !
I love these! They feel very nice and cool on the skin and are very hydrating. I would definitely recommend this product!
I've never had an under-eye product actually reduce my puffiness and this one makes a huge difference even after 10 mins! I love these
Great for the undereye area. Thin and easy to apply. They stay in place so you dont have to lie down while theyre on your face. Didnt irritate my eyes or skin.
They stay in place and I could feel the cooling affects an hour after removing them. I've tried a few different undereye patches recently and these are my favorite so far!
These are great for hydrating and depuffing your under eyes. They are thin and stay in place. A staple in my skincare routine.
The eye patches felt very comfortable and when I was done with the under-eye area, I flipped them and placed them on the marionette lines around my mouth. Definitely plan to repurchase.

avis.titre: These are very hydrating and cooling
avis.texte: I am very happy with this product as a 39 year old with aging skin. It's extremely hydrating and depufs under my eyes. These stay on great while I do laundry if I scrape a little of the serum off.
I noticed a serious difference in my under eye dullness after only a few days.
Great for somone like me that have very sensitive under eyes, and needs that EXTRA hydration to avoid wrinkles.

I was hesitant to buy these because there were no reviews. I really like them. They're thin which is what i was hoping for. Theyre cooling and most importantly they dont burn my eyes! They help with depuffing. I keep them in my fridge so they feel nice and cool.

I have been on the search for good under eye patches. These are awesome! You get a ton for the price. and they actually stay in place instead of slowly sliding down my cheeks. They take away puffiness and I look more awake after using in the morning.

I experienced an adverse reaction around my eyes to a product from a different brand I that I unknowingly applied without realizing it was expired, so I resorted to using these (as well as other COSRX products) for the days that followed and after few days of using these after my skincare routine, the redness and irritation I had was pretty much gone for good. I ended up putting them in my mini fridge to make them cool to the touch and this definitely made them feel amazing once I applied them to my upper and under eye areas. Sort of like a nice, cool and relaxing resting treatment for the skin around my eyes, so I'll definitely be buying more once I run out of these.

These feel so great for the morning eye. Fun to use while prepping breakfast and keeps skin hydrated all day. And very good for sunscreen or light make up base. It's so hydrating to the touch too. Nicely done, COSRX!

I like the convenience of the packaging and ease of application. I've been sleeping in mine because I like how soft my skin feels in the morning. I have used other under eye products which made me break out. My sensitive, rosacea skin did not react to this. I will continue to use.
These are my new go to under eye mask! I love this brand, the products never disappoint

I like the way these feel. They seem to make the skin around my eyes brighter and my dark circles look less obvious. There is a large amount of the product in the tub. They are a little tricky to remove but the included spatula helps.

I love when they sell eye patches in these containers instead of individually! My under eyes can be sensitive to certain patches but these didn't bother me at all. I love peptides and collagen in the eye patches too

I heard somewhere that peptides are the gold standard for skin care so I did a search and found these gems! My eyes are so tired looking and sallow. The patches go on easily and feel hydrating. My eyes are looking much better now & I plan to purchase again.
So far I've only used this once but it felt very nourishing. It did tend to slide down my face a little but with some readjusting, it was great!
I've only used these 2 times, I just received them. But I did notice my eye bags were smaller after about 15 minutes of wear. I will definitely continue to use in the morning.
It's hard to apply (sticky and slippery), but the actual product is quite effective. I noticed my dark under eye circles looked a lot lighter after just one use!
Have been using for a week, leaves skin soft and glowy but still need more time to see if there's lasting results!
Love! I use so many cosrx products. Love a good eye patch and this one is great. Reducing morning puffiness.
exciting to try new product! it's easy and convenient. small patch easy around and undereye areas or smaller areas of concerns
These eye patches are so refreshing! It helped a lot under my eye.

Haven't used this product for long but I already love it. The eye patches are well made and cover a good amount of under eye skin. The patches lay comfortably on the skin, have a good amount of product. They don't slide about, I wore them while driving! I look forward to using these!
First time trying them they didn't stay put very well. Kept sliding down my cheeks so I had to lay down for a bit. When I removed them my undereyes looked more plump and hydrated.

I changed to this eye patches from the snail mucin ones and although both are good at hydrating my undereye area these ones have helped with my puffiness in the mornings! As a tip I'd say to keep them in the fridge. I also recieved my package fast and I was able to use my reward points for extra discounts so make sure you join the rewards program! I love the cosrx service online !
These do help brighten up my undereye area. My skin looks hydrated. They are hard to get out though. Very slippery and I feel like half the product comes off in my hands before I get it on my face.
My favorite morning routine is to put on the Peptide Collagen Hydrogel Eye Patch! It doesn't slip or slide on the skin and the cooling effect is the pick up I need before work.
These eye patches are very hydrating. They feel comfortable on the skin and immediately improve a dry or tired undereye area. I would definitely recommend them.
Absolutely love these. Noticed a difference in my eye bags right away after one use!

I'm obsessed with these eye patches! They feel really nice on the skin and make my under eyes look so hydrated and plump after using! the packaging is also really nice and makes it easy to grab each patch.
Love this product so far, stays on skin and feels really hydrating.
Love them! Love the feeling and although it hasn't been long I can tell already it's worth buying! Love my skin care routine products and excited to be able to these.
